We will provide you with a booking confirmation email that will have critical details about your trip and will call you the evening prior to departure. We accept all major credit cards for bookings. ​Under normal circumstances, a 14-day refund policy is in effect. blurb: They offer guided fishing trips on the Kenai and Kasilof Rivers for Pacific Salmon and Trophy Rainbow Trout. Trips include full day, half day, 3/4 day, and private excursions. They provide all fishing equipment including waders, heated boat, rods, tackle, flies, and safety equipment.

quotes.text: Went out with Dave for a half day trip. Took my dad, brother, and wife who have never fly fished before and had a blast. Dave was awesome and very hospitable. Caught some rainbows, dollys, and silvers. Awesome experience, we will definitely be back next summer!

This was my first fishing trip in Alaska, but from the experience it’s going to be hard to beat! Our guide never stopped working to try and put us on the fish and kept us laughing the whole time to boot! Thanks again Brian and Dave!

An absolute amazing guide service! I have been able to be around the fly fishing industry for a long time and I don’t think I have ever met a guide service more professional and friendly, especially in Alaska.
Amazing half day of fishing on the Upper Kenai [River] with Dave. Very knowledgeable and friendly. My sister had never gone fishing before and landed 5 fish!
...really the highlight of our vacation. I truly don’t have enough words to praise Dave. We have fished with other guides...
